placements.why: src-1 declares the signed-manifest requirement for Meridian deploys; src-2 supplies the incident-based motivation (unsigned artifacts reaching staging); src-3 and src-4 define the gate and its environmental scope. Together they establish a thematic subject — the signed-manifest gate for Meridian — that future envelopes can continue to feed. src-2's incident detail is evidence for this leaf, not a leaf of its own.
